cues.en: In the past, several videos you've learned about one way to multiply two vectors, and it's called the DOT product or the inner product, there is another way to multiply two vectors, and that is called

cues.en: The outer product is defined between two vectors.
cues.zh: 外積定義在兩個向量之間。

cues.en: And unlike the DOT product or the inner product, the outer product can be computed between two vectors that actually have different lengths.
cues.zh: 與內積不同，外積其實可以在長度不同的兩向量之間計算。

cues.en: So in this particular example, you see two vectors that are both four dimensional.
cues.zh: 這個例子，兩個向量都是四維。

cues.en: Well, it looks like this the outer product between two vectors is an entire matrix.
cues.zh: 像這樣，兩向量的外積是一整個矩陣。

cues.en: So how to think about this matrix?
cues.zh: 怎麼理解這個矩陣？

cues.en: Well, notice that all of the columns of this matrix are the same as the column here.
cues.zh: 注意，矩陣所有欄都和這裡的欄一樣。

cues.en: So this left vector and all the rows of this matrix here, the outer product matrix are just repeats of this vector here.
cues.zh: 也就是左邊這個向量；而外積矩陣的所有列，都只是這個向量的重複。

cues.en: So the row vector on the right.
cues.zh: 也就是右邊的列向量。

cues.en: And that's essentially the way that you build up the outer product matrix.
cues.zh: 基本上，就是這樣建立外積矩陣。

cues.en: You take the column vector on the left and you just repeat those columns for however many elements.
cues.zh: 取左側欄向量，重複那些欄，次數對應，

cues.en: There are rows in the right vector here and all the rows in the outer product are just repeats of this row vector on the right for however many elements are in this column vector on the left.
cues.zh: 右側向量有多少元素；外積裡所有列，都是右側列向量的重複，次數則對應左側欄向量的元素個數。
